name: Tomoe Yukina
source:
Yukina Tomoe is Shizuma’s other osananajimi and [url=/c1503]Makina’s[/url] older twin sister. However she is the complete opposite of Makina in terms of personality. She is more mature and academically proficient but does not have much athletic ability. Even though she is more mature than her sister, she does show her “angry” smile when Makina goes out of bounds, scaring her witless. She also has strange quirks in her personality such as an odd sense of fashion and her eagerness to give back-breaking massages. Yukina is a very good cook and likes gardening. 

[Edited from [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=374]m3rryweather's review[/url].]
